record.question: Who was the last Governor General of India?
record.explanation: The President's official 2012 speech records Rajagopalachari's term from 21 June 1948 to 26 January 1950, ending when India became a republic. He was the last Governor-General. Historical exam context: 2010-03-24 (full date printed on cover). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed. Evidence: https://www.presidentofindia.gov.in/sites/default/files/sp080912.pdf Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
